name: MFCB
recent: MFCB 近期公告主要是主席兼执行董事 Goh Nan Kioh 在闭门期内的连续增持，以及大股东 Keen Capital Investments Limited 和 EPF 的股权变动申报。同期没有新的合约、企业活动或监管事件公布。
notable: 主席兼执行董事 Goh Nan Kioh 在 2026 年 10 月 28 日至 11 月 13 日期间多次在公开市场增持公司股份。
大股东 Keen Capital Investments Limited 及 EPF 的股权变动已按 Section 138 作出申报。
risks: 董事在闭门期内进行交易，相关交易已按上市条例第 14 章申报。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 MYR 328.72 million，环比增长 7.8%，同比减少 3.3%；净利为 MYR 59.39 million，环比减少 4.7%，同比减少 29.9%；净利率为 18.1%，低于上一季度的 20.4%。

recent_en: MFCB's recent announcements mainly comprise consecutive share acquisitions by Chairman and Executive Director Goh Nan Kioh during the closed period, along with changes in substantial shareholder interests for Keen Capital Investments Limited and EPF. No new contracts, corporate exercises or regulatory events were announced in the same period.
notable_en: Chairman and Executive Director Goh Nan Kioh acquired shares in the company on multiple occasions in the open market between 28 October and 13 November 2026.
Changes in the interests of substantial shareholders Keen Capital Investments Limited and EPF were announced under Section 138.
risks_en: The director traded during the closed period, and the dealings were announced under Chapter 14 of the Listing Requirements.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 328.72 million, up 7.8% QoQ but down 3.3% YoY; net income was MYR 59.39 million, down 4.7% QoQ and 29.9% YoY; net margin was 18.1%, lower than 20.4% in the previous quarter.
